trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document), (p)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t:Team {team_name: 'Cedevita Olimpija'}) WHERE r.tenure = 'latest' RETURN (2026 - CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) - CASE WHEN CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) > 10 OR (CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) = 10 AND CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS col1, p.birth_date AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, p.name AS name_player
